article_title: Graduates jobs: More work with AI but what else?

tasks.prompt: What central question does the article explore?
options: Whether AI-focused graduate jobs provide greater responsibility while still teaching enough traditional professional skills
Whether every graduate should stop using AI immediately
Whether universities should replace degrees with chatbots
Whether AI agents can legally become company directors
tasks.correct_answer: Whether AI-focused graduate jobs provide greater responsibility while still teaching enough traditional professional skills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה שואלת האם תפקידי בוגרים ממוקדי בינה מלאכותית מעניקים אחריות והתקדמות, אך גם מאפשרים ללמוד את יסודות המקצוע.

tasks.prompt: What is a major part of Lotte Underwood's role?
options: Writing every client article without technology
Managing AI agents, checking their outputs and sharing useful results with colleagues
Training university lecturers to award degrees
Replacing all direct client meetings with automated calls
tasks.correct_answer: Managing AI agents, checking their outputs and sharing useful results with colleagues
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אנדרווד מנהלת סוכני AI, בודקת את התוצרים שלהם ומעבירה תוצאות לעמיתים שעובדים מול לקוחות והתקשורת.

tasks.prompt: What does “AI savvy graduates” mean in the article?
options: Graduates who refuse to automate any work
Graduates employed only in financial services
Graduates knowledgeable and capable in using AI
Graduates who designed the first chatbot
tasks.correct_answer: Graduates knowledgeable and capable in using AI
tasks.explanation_hebrew: AI savvy מתאר בוגרים שמבינים בבינה מלאכותית ויודעים להשתמש בה ביעילות.

tasks.prompt: What did PwC find about entry-level roles most influenced by AI?
options: They require fewer skills than before.
They have disappeared completely since 2019.
They are limited to public relations.
They are seven times more likely to require traditionally senior-level skills.
tasks.correct_answer: They are seven times more likely to require traditionally senior-level skills.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחקר PwC מצא שתפקידי כניסה המושפעים ביותר מ־AI נוטים פי שבעה לדרוש מיומנויות שנחשבו בעבר לבכירות.

tasks.prompt: Why does Cian Clinton say AI is “killing the pyramid approach” to career progression?
options: AI lets junior staff contribute ideas and assume responsibilities earlier, so advancement depends less on years of accumulated knowledge.
AI prevents graduates from communicating with senior staff.
Companies no longer need critical thinking.
Every employee now has the same salary and job title.
tasks.correct_answer: AI lets junior staff contribute ideas and assume responsibilities earlier, so advancement depends less on years of accumulated knowledge.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: קלינטון טוען ש־AI מאפשר לעובדים צעירים לבצע עבודה אחראית מוקדם יותר, ולכן הקידום תלוי פחות בוותק ובמאגר ידע בלבד.

tasks.prompt: What does “AI-centric” mean in the discussion of graduate roles?
options: Designed for employees in a city centre
Focused too heavily or mainly on AI
Opposed to all new technology
Based on rotating through four departments
tasks.correct_answer: Focused too heavily or mainly on AI
tasks.explanation_hebrew: AI-centric פירושו תפקיד שממוקד בעיקר או במידה רבה מדי בבינה מלאכותית.

tasks.prompt: Compare Lotte Underwood's AI-focused role with Portman Finance Group's graduate programme.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג הבדל ברור במוקד העבודה ובאופן הלמידה של הבוגרים.
expected_points: Underwood mainly manages and applies AI agents in public relations work.
She has not yet gained some traditional PR experience, such as directly pitching to the media.
Portman's graduates rotate through four areas at six-month intervals.
They work with senior relationship managers and learn products, credit papers, customer relationships and complete transactions.

tasks.prompt: What are the main opportunities and risks of giving graduates senior-level responsibilities through AI?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנתח לפחות יתרון אחד וסיכון אחד תוך שימוש בדוגמאות או טענות מהכתבה.
expected_points: AI can let graduates implement ideas, contribute value and progress faster.
Junior employees can take on strategic decision-making, leadership and team-building expectations earlier.
Heavy AI focus may leave gaps in traditional sector knowledge and client-facing skills.
Higher expectations may place senior-level demands on inexperienced workers.
Long-term progression requires combining AI literacy with professional expertise.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how AI is changing graduate jobs and the debate about career development in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול דוגמאות לתפקידי AI, ממצאי PwC, יתרונות האחריות המוקדמת והחשש מפערי ידע מקצועי.
expected_points: Companies are creating graduate roles that build, manage and apply AI agents across business functions.
PwC found that AI-influenced entry-level jobs increasingly demand skills once associated with senior staff.
Graduates such as Clinton feel more valued and expect faster progression.
However, Underwood and employers such as Portman highlight the need to learn traditional professional skills.
Experts argue that AI literacy must be paired with sector and client knowledge.

tasks.prompt: Design a brief recommendation for an employer creating an AI-focused graduate programme.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע תכנית מאוזנת המשלבת AI, ידע מקצועי, פיקוח אנושי והתפתחות הדרגתית.
expected_points: Teach graduates to build or manage AI tools and critically check their outputs.
Include rotations or direct work with experienced professionals.
Provide traditional sector training and client-facing experience.
Increase responsibility while offering supervision and feedback.
Measure both AI literacy and development of professional judgement.
